entries.what: Slept in until 9, then studied subnetting at the kitchen table in the Verdant Commons apartment while Iris was at work.
entries.outcome: Finished one chapter of drills before heading out.

entries.what: Filled up at the Ruel Road station and drove 9 minutes to start her 1 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. overtime swing. Ana from HR told her the temporary lead-duties differential kicks in this pay period, bringing her to $31.90 an hour.
entries.outcome: Pay bump confirmed, still no title.

entries.what: Spent the evening in the cage triaging dead scanners and updating the RMA sheet, with Bao handling battery swaps.
entries.outcome: Cleared a dozen handhelds before the night shift ran out of spares.

entries.what: Quiet morning, then drove to work for the 1 p.m. swing. Trained Bao on scanner repairs from 3 to 5 in the cage.
entries.outcome: Bao managed a trigger board swap on his own.

entries.what: Carla texted her cell about three dead scanners on the outbound dock; Noemi walked over and swapped them out.
entries.outcome: Dock back at rate before the midnight rush.

entries.what: Got home near midnight and ate leftover rice with Iris, who was still up with the budget sheet.
entries.outcome: Agreed to talk about the December trip money later.

entries.what: Studied port numbers with the practice-test app before shift.
entries.outcome: Still missing a handful on well-known ports.

entries.what: Worked the overtime swing, handling a battery batch problem and some badge reader tickets.
entries.outcome: Tickets closed, RMA sheet updated.

entries.what: On a break she got a breach alert email about an old shopping account and realized she used the same password on it as on nearly everything personal.
entries.outcome: Changed that one password and started listing which accounts shared it.

entries.what: Iris and Noemi talked at breakfast about her old resume, last touched in 2022. Noemi hesitated to list the lead-coverage work as her own.
entries.outcome: Talked into writing it as her own work, building a new one-page resume that lists RF-4 lead-coverage duties.

entries.what: Drove in for the swing and trained Bao on scanner repairs from 3 to 5. Victor passed along a vendor ticket on his way out.
entries.outcome: Took the vendor ticket without comment.

entries.what: Late in the shift, she and Bao cleared the cage backlog.
entries.outcome: Cage down to about 25 scanners.

entries.what: Worked the overtime swing on Halloween. Pickers in costume jokes aside, several handhelds froze mid-shift.
entries.outcome: Rebooted and reimaged a few; a red-beep night.

entries.what: Got Taquería Colima for shift dinner, her Friday habit.
entries.outcome: Ate in the cage between tickets.

entries.what: Got home after 11:30, and Iris had left candy from the apartment's trick-or-treaters on the counter.
entries.outcome: Shared candy and watched part of a show.

entries.what: Spent Saturday morning migrating personal accounts into a password manager, working through the list from Wednesday's breach scare, with a checklist to track which accounts were done.
entries.outcome: Most accounts moved over and given unique passwords.

entries.what: Short walk on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk, careful of slick planks.
entries.outcome: Cleared her head.

entries.what: Afternoon subnetting drills at the home desk.
entries.outcome: Did a full set before dinner.

entries.what: Slept late, then went through the last of the password manager imports.
entries.outcome: All accounts moved.

entries.what: Iris dropped hints about their Nov 15 anniversary; Noemi asked which restaurant Iris would pick and booked a Calle Ortega dinner for 7 p.m.
entries.outcome: Reservation made for Nov 15.

entries.what: Sunday night co-op survival game with her online squad as packetloss_.
entries.outcome: Won a long raid.
